newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen rated attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen rated attractive.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Elise Wang reinitiated Amgen Inc with an attractive rating.
-- estimated earnings of $2.83 for 1997, and $3.16 for 1998, $3.70 for 1999, $4.22 for 2000.
-- set price target of $70-$75 in 12 months.
-- disputes some views that company is "trapped in adolescence," with investors debating whether it is a biotech company or a pharmaceutical company.
-- said Amgen has strengths in both areas -- as a biotech company it has a "robust" product line, and has some top pharmaceutical products.
-- sees some "real trading opportunities," especially as news come out on products.
